text:
lina: quick heads-up — new onboarded model cedar-liteq (int4) is producing NDJSON blobs that sometimes merge into a single invalid array when batch+streaming used. parse errors up from 0.6% -> 4.8% on toolcall harness.
omar: interesting, sample slice and config?
lina: bench-ci ran 2k-toolcall-sample, config: cedar-liteq, quant=int4, batch=16, streaming=on, kvcache=off. run summary below.
bench-ci: run bc-1749 summary:
```
samples: 2000
parse_failure_rate: 0.048
common_err: JSONDecodeError(Expecting ',' or ']' at line 1)
mode: ndjson_stream_concatenation
```
devon: can we see minimal failing output?
lina: pasted sanitized example (two separate toolcall objects got merged into a single array without comma):
```
[{"action":"call","name":"fetch","arguments":{"id":"a1"}}{"action":"call","name":"fetch","arguments":{"id":"a2"}}]
```
omar: ah — looks like model emitted consecutive JSON objects inside array but missed comma between objects. When stream fragments are stitched back together the comma token was dropped. int4 quant often nudges punctuation tokens low probability.
devon: triage plan: 1) rerun with batch_size=1 streaming=false to see if batching causes join 2) quick postprocess: try line-split/ndjson-parse fallback and if that succeeds, rewrap into array for caller 3) gate large batch sizes for int4 models until we have a kernel fix.
bench-ci: queued bc-1750: batch=1, stream=false, limit=1000.
ops-bot: automated note: canary parse failure >3% — hold promotion of cedar-liteq-int4.
lina: running quick ndjson-repair heuristic locally: split on '}{' boundaries and insert comma, then validate. naive but fixes ~60% of failures in sample.
omar: please add telemetry tag `x-json-repair=ndjson-insert` on repaired calls so we can measure false positives. Also capture token-level logits for a subset to debug why comma got dropped.
devon: i'll add a runtime rule to block batch>4 for quant=int4 models in the next hour. also add canary unit-test that simulates adjacency of objects across streaming chunk boundaries.
bench-ci: bc-1750 interim: batch=1 run parse_fail dropped to 0.009. good signal that batching is amplifying issue. full 2k rerun with repair enabled queued bc-1751.
bench-ci: bc-1751 completed: repair_success_fraction=0.062 (repaired many), false_repair_est=0.003 on gold subset. overall parse_fail now 0.011 with repairs+batch_limit. logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-1751/logs
lina: owners: devon -> runtime gating for int4 batch limits + unit tests; omar -> collect logits/golden traces for debug; lina -> ship ndjson-repair in SDK canary and add telemetry header; bench-ci -> produce final regression dashboard.
ops-bot: incident ticket INC-1749 created to track.
lina: summary: root cause likely int4 punctuation token rank shift combined with batching/stream stitch. mitigations: temporary batch cap for int4, SDK ndjson-repair fallback, telemetry for repairs and token traces. will revisit after kernel/quant calibration.
omar: thanks, will add failing examples to /s3/eng-ml/goldens/cedar-liteq/ for model team.
lina: closing thread when dashboard stable <1%.
